title: Visibility
description: When the plot is shown: during gameplay only, also on the results screen, or always. It only appears in osu!standard, the only ruleset with hit offsets.

title: Point size (px)
description: Diameter of each hit at the plot's centre distance; new hits start larger and shrink to this size as they fade

title: Fade duration (s)
description: Seconds a new hit stays emphasised (larger, brighter, with a line down to the zero-error ring) before it settles into the history

title: Faded opacity
description: Opacity of older hits, from 0 (hidden) to 1 (as bright as new hits)

title: Max points
description: How many of the most recent hits are drawn; older hits of the play are kept but not shown

title: Auto-rotate speed (°/s)
description: Camera orbit speed in degrees per second; 0 stops it, negative values rotate the other way

title: Show axis labels
description: Directions, the px scale and the timing window edges in ms

title: Show info
description: Title, hit count, average error, circle size with the hit-circle radius, and the renderer in use

title: 300 colour
description: Hits inside the 300 (great) timing window, and that window's rings

title: 100 colour
description: Hits inside the 100 (ok) timing window, and that window's rings

title: 50 colour
description: Hits inside the 50 (meh) timing window, and that window's rings
